newsitem.title: USA: PANASONIC READY TO LAUNCH DVD PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: PANASONIC READY TO LAUNCH DVD PLAYERS.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd's Panasonic unit and Toshiba Corp expect to begin shipping digital video-disk (DVD) players by November as they come close to reaching an agreement with movie studios over copyright protection, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday.
The newspaper said Sony Corp and Philips Electronics NV had postponed launching their players until next spring.

It said Hollywood studios, computer makers and consumer electronics manufacturers were close to reaching an agreement to allow production of the players without violating copyright, which the studios had feared.
The players, designed to play movie-quality video and compact disks, ran the risk of enabling consumers to copy and violate copyright laws, the newspaper said.

But the studios, computer makers and electronics manufacturers appear to be on the verge of signing a deal that would have the players scramble the data and prevent their users from making any copies, it said.
